criterion: the instrument recovers a known-present case: under leave-one-out on the 66 derivation proteins, the observed catalytic [YF]xDD lies inside the predicted dyad-carrying region interval
declared_threshold: at least 95 percent of the 66 folds
rationale: governance requires a positive control before any absence or non-detection claim; and an instrument that cannot find the dyad on its own derivation substrate cannot be read on anything else
consequence_if_failed: g4 lands as an impossibility result; the detector is not frozen; g5 does not run

criterion: the instrument can fail: composition-preserving shuffles and non-RT decoys do not receive confident calls
declared_threshold: at most 1 percent of 1000 shuffles receive PRESENT_HIGH_CONF on any region
rationale: a detector that calls everything has no information; g2's own C4 control FAILED and that failure is why block count is not a target here
consequence_if_failed: the method is withdrawn before any of its other numbers is read
denominator: 1000 shuffles plus the declared non-RT set

criterion: region-interval stability is measured and regions are classified by it
declared_threshold: median IoU at least 0.70 across the declared perturbation ensemble for a region to be reported as STABLE
rationale: the landed cross-frame Jaccards are 0.739, 1.000, 0.911, 0.410, 0.955, 1.000; a 0.70 bar separates region 4 from the rest and was chosen from the landed distribution before any new derivation, not after
consequence_if_failed: regions below the bar are reported as UNSTABLE and carry no interval claim; region 4 is expected to fail and that expectation is recorded now

rationale: launcher section 1: failure to transfer is a result, not a failed track. Setting a bar here would create an incentive to tune toward it
consequence_if_failed: none - the number is the result

criterion: structural correspondence is reported as containment, not as agreement
rationale: fingers/palm/thumb is a different representation; a disagreement is a finding about two instruments, not a detector error
consequence_if_failed: none - the number is the result
denominator: structures in the arm after exclusions

criterion: every landed number names its frame, stratum, unit and denominator, resolved through a claim registry built before execution
declared_threshold: 100 percent; an unresolved entry fails the build
rationale: launcher section 9d; failed-review blocker 17 - a promise is not a registry

criterion: BOUNDARY_ACCURACY and BOUNDARY_CALIBRATION are declared UNESTABLISHED in the bundle, the report and the model card
rationale: estimand_matrix.tsv Q08 and Q16; declared before any method is chosen so that it cannot be read as an excuse after one fails
consequence_if_failed: n/a - this is an output, not a test

criterion: no RT0 occupancy of any kind is produced, and RT0 is reported OUT_OF_FRAME outside admissible classes
rationale: g2 created no RT0 block, g3 returned OBJECT_MISMATCH, and the defining cross-class claim is NOT_TESTABLE_ON_SUBSTRATE. U01 remains open

criterion: region 1 / RT1 is scored by the same preregistered rule as every other region, with no region-specific threshold or post-hoc method choice
rationale: failed-review repair 9; and U08 - the interpretation of the RT1 failure remains an operator decision and is not settled by g4

criterion: the portable package passes its acceptance tests: invalid residues, fragments, low-complexity input, multi-hit sequences, shuffled and non-RT decoys, out-of-distribution input, byte-reproducibility of a rerun, and split/merge behaviour on the unstable region
declared_threshold: all tests present and passing, or the package does not ship
consequence_if_failed: the detector is not frozen and g5 does not run
